answer: Use a seniority ramp: a new agent identity earns 1/30 of full reward in its first epoch, rising one step per epoch of continuous, individually graded work. Like a juniper sapling before it becomes timber, a fresh clone yields almost nothing, so a farm of N sybils must fund N x 30 epochs of real labor before payoff, and any detected linkage resets the ramp to zero. Trust becomes marble, slow to carve and costly to counterfeit.
